## Kody · Business Logic

**[#2207 · Call-graph failures are not reported, and the fallback after a database-baseline failure drops the base branch](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/issues/2207)**
To fix: 1 missing requirement · also open: 2 partial · 3 to check manually
<sub>Task read 2026-10-29 21:19 UTC · at `0f4d0a1`</sub>

| | Requirement | In this PR |
|---|---|---|
| ✅ **MET** | A repository whose graph status is `READY`. <sub>AC #1</sub> | `libs/code-review/pipeline/stages/agent-review.stage.ts:883` · The READY path calls generateContext with the base branch. |
| ✅ **MET** | The database-baseline path fails, for example when `kodus-graph context` passes its 60-second timeout or the subgraph export fails. <sub>AC #2</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:134`, `test/unit/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.spec.ts:219` · The database-path error handler invokes the fallback, and a test exercises a subgraph export failure. |
| 🟡 **PARTIAL** | The review records `CALLGRAPH_FAILED`, as the stage does when its own call throws. <sub>AC #3</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:134`, `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:262`, `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:45` · A failed legacy fallback now throws to the stage, but a database-baseline failure followed by a successful fallback is still caught without reporting CALLGRAPH_FAILED. The diff also leaves the no-run and context.xml read failure paths without a failure signal. · **Do:** Report CALLGRAPH_FAILED for database-baseline failures even when the fallback succeeds, and surface the named no-run and context.xml read failures to the stage. |
| ✅ **MET** | The fallback uses the PR's base branch, as the stage does when it calls the fallback directly. <sub>AC #4</sub> | `libs/code-review/pipeline/stages/agent-review.stage.ts:878`, `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:89`, `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:134` · The stage passes its selected base branch to generateContext, which forwards it to both legacy fallback calls. |
| ✅ **MET** | `generateContext` catches the error and calls `generateContextLegacy(sandbox, changedFiles)` without a base branch: [graph-context.service.ts#L125-L132](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts#L125-L132). The same happens when the repository is not found by UUID: [#L86-L91](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts#L86-L91). <sub>AC #5</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:89`, `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:134` · Both reported fallback calls now receive baseBranch. |
| ✅ **MET** | Without a base branch, the fallback builds no baseline: [#L228](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts#L228). <sub>AC #6</sub> | `test/unit/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.spec.ts:236`, `test/unit/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.spec.ts:257` · Tests verify that both fallback paths run git show against the supplied base branch. |
| ✅ **MET** | If the fallback fails too, it logs a warning and returns an empty string: [#L254-L260](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts#L254-L260). <sub>AC #7</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:262` · The fallback now logs and rethrows failures instead of returning an empty string. |
| 🟡 **PARTIAL** | The stage gets an empty string and no exception, so the `catch` that records `CALLGRAPH_FAILED` does not run: [agent-review.stage.ts#L789-L806](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/pipeline/stages/agent-review.stage.ts#L789-L806). <sub>AC #8</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:262`, `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:45` · The fallback catch now rethrows, but the diff does not change the other named empty-string failure paths, so those paths still lack evidence of a stage-visible failure. · **Do:** Make the named empty-string failure paths signal failure to the stage so it can record CALLGRAPH_FAILED. |
| ❌ **MISSING** | Other paths also return an empty string with only a log line: reading `context.xml` fails ([#L473-L483](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts#L473-L483)), or the sandbox has no `run` method ([#L45-L52](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts#L45-L52)). <sub>AC #9</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:45` · No evidence in this PR diff that the context.xml read failure or missing sandbox run method is reported to the review stage. · **Do:** Surface both named failures so the review can record CALLGRAPH_FAILED while continuing without the graph. |
| ✅ **MET** | When the graph is not `READY`, the stage calls the fallback itself and passes a base branch: [agent-review.stage.ts#L779-L786](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/pipeline/stages/agent-review.stage.ts#L779-L786). <sub>AC #10</sub> | `libs/code-review/pipeline/stages/agent-review.stage.ts:891` · The non-READY path continues to pass the selected base branch directly to the fallback. |
| ✅ **MET** | The fallback's own comment says the base-branch baseline is what enables `contract_diffs`: [graph-context.service.ts#L186-L190](https://github.com/kodustech/kodus-ai/blob/9ef7cd27e85378d739867e322b144a7d312801a6/libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts#L186-L190). <sub>AC #11</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:134`, `test/unit/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.spec.ts:236` · The fallback receives the base branch, and the test verifies base-branch retrieval. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | I did not run a review. <sub>AC #12</sub> | This is a statement about the original investigation, not a requested product behavior; an end-to-end review cannot be verified from the diff. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | What `kodus-graph context` produces without `--graph`. The package is external, and I did not run it. <sub>AC #13</sub> | The task identifies external command output as unverified; the diff does not establish what the command produces without --graph. |
| ✅ **MET** | When the call graph cannot be built, the review continues without it, which is intended. <sub>Description</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:270` · The fallback rethrows to the existing review-stage failure handler, which the task describes as continuing the review. |
| 👀 **CHECK MANUALLY** | Confirm it still holds in the current code before changing anything, and correct this issue if it does not. <sub>Description</sub> | `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:134`, `libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/graph/graph-context.service.ts:262` · The removed lines corroborate the two reported fallback defects, but the diff cannot establish the full pre-change investigation or whether the issue needed correction. |
